flaws.description: Swapped sns.scatterplot for sns.lineplot at its single call site, keeping all keyword arguments unchanged since lineplot also supports hue, size, sizes, palette and alpha; this connects the data points with lines instead of showing them as discrete markers.

Filtered the DataFrame passed to sns.lineplot to exclude 'Congo (Democratic)', removing that country's entire series from the scatter/line plot while leaving the data definition, legend slicing, and everything else untouched.
